title: UI tests with Testing Library: querying by role and label

objectives.text: Render a component in a test with React Testing Library and find elements with getByRole by accessible name and with getByLabelText
Choose getBy, queryBy or findBy for an element that is present, absent or appears asynchronously
Simulate typing and clicking with user-event and assert on what the user can see

minutes.basis: Measured on the authored artifact.html with the frozen estimator (authoring/tools/timing/estimate_reading.py): P50 7.17 minutes. Budget and about label are 11: the larger of the intake plan of 10 and ceil(max(P50, worst path)), under the 15-minute ceiling (authoring/docs/tools/validators.md).
